# LoomTension

Two threads in tension: they contradict each other, one appears to replace the other, or they hold different perspectives. Tensions are recorded, never forced to a resolution; use settles them over time, and they stay visible until then.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loomId` | `uuid` | The loom. |
| `threadId1` | `uuid` | The first thread. |
| `threadId2` | `uuid` | The second thread. |
| `kind` | [`TensionKind`](tension-kind.md) | What sort of tension it is. |
| `note` | `string` | What the tension is, in a sentence. |
| `subjectKeys` | `string[]` | The subjects of the two threads, lowercase, so the tapestry can raise tensions about the people present. |
| `detectedBy` | [`ThreadOrigin`](thread-origin.md) | Who noticed the tension, and from where. |
| `dateResolved` | `datetime \| null` | When the tension was resolved (UTC). Null while it is open. |
| `resolution` | `string \| null` | How it was resolved, in the resolver's words. Null while it is open. |
| `resolvedBy` | [`ThreadOrigin`](thread-origin.md)`\| null` | Who resolved it. Null while it is open. |
| `isOpen` | `boolean` | True until the tension is resolved. Set by Maitento. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |
